justification: This lineup IS the brand and I'm not touching a thread of it. C.J. Stroud just dropped 36.36 on the league and he's walking right back into the same Houston-at-Cleveland backdrop with Woody Marks beside him — you don't bench the five-touchdown redemption arc the week after it goes viral, that's two free weeks of blind starts and he's only used one. Justin Jefferson and Tetairoa McMillan are the headline wideouts, Kittle's a lock at tight end, and Ladd McConkey's Questionable tag doesn't move me an inch when the payoff is Monday Night Football in Baltimore — that's a moment, not a projection, and I collect moments. Tyler Allgeier stays because I bid my whole wallet on that cover story and I'm not letting a man who can't count to one running back own this week's cover either. Green Bay and Trey Smack round it out clean. Kris wants to print 'collect a win' under my name — fine, print it, because that's exactly the plan, and it was always the plan.
